claim: Linear attention with separate key and query weights learns principal axes one at a time, on predicted loss plateaus
result: All 16 predicted plateaus matched to 5-6 decimals; axes switch on in eigenvalue order

claim: A trained linear self-attention layer implements one preconditioned gradient-descent step
result: The converged weights equal the analytic one-step solution to about 1e-14

claim: Simplified Muon converges at a rate independent of the condition number; gradient descent does not
result: Gradient descent slows with the condition number; Muon does not, aligned or rotated

paper: Saxe et al. / Dragutinović et al. 2026
claim: In a deep linear network gradient descent learns modes one at a time; spectral descent learns them together
result: Gradient descent sequential, spectral descent parallel, both unchanged by rotation

claim: A GPT-2 matches least squares in context and fails on a skewed test covariance
result: Matches least squares in distribution; the skewed-covariance failure appears for an AdamW-trained model

claim: Rotating the whole parameter space slows Adam sharply
result: AdamW in a rotated parameter space never leaves the plateau in our GPT-2
Faster early training; the size of the skewed-covariance failure depends on training details
